description: Land Acquisition - Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.No. 1248/18 of 08.08.2001 D/S Division, and Lands in Muppane D/S Division, Monaragala, Monaragala District, Thumbowila, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
reasoning: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes (school construction, official quarters, etc.), provides detailed land descriptions including lot numbers, names, claimants, and extents, and outlines the legal process for compensation claims. This fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals specifically with land acquisition and property matters.
